name: lauxiliaire
description: Chrome extension for reading French in place — on-device translation, contextual vocabulary, conjugation, PDFs and spoken practice

comments.no-type-module: Deliberately no "type": "module". The extension's own code is ES modules, but scripts/ is CommonJS (require). Flipping this field would break the build scripts; scripts/check-syntax.js handles the two dialects instead.
comments.no-dependencies: There is no build step and no runtime dependency. The repo IS the extension — `npm install` is not needed to load it unpacked. These scripts are hand-run helpers and guards.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:refs && npm run check:contrast
